question.question_text: Select the correct statement regarding the spatial proximity of objects in the kitchen

answer_options.text: The drawer is integrated into the chopping board
The cooking stick is closer to the cooking pot than the dishwasher
The bin is mounted above the cooker
The kettle is closer to the cooker than the pot

shared_investigation.established_facts: The video shows a person peeling an onion on a cutting board, then opening a drawer, stirring a pot on the stove, and holding a bin. No bin, drawer, cooking stick, dishwasher, or kettle is visible in the uncertainty notes of the reviewed visual findings. The cooking stick, dishwasher, and kettle are not mentioned in any of the visual observations. The only objects mentioned are onion, knife, cutting board, table, bin, drawer, pot, stove, and kitchen counter. There is no mention of the cooking stick, dishwasher, or kettle in any of the visual observations. The bin is not described as being mounted above the cooker. The kettle is not mentioned as being closer to the cooker than the pot. The drawer is not described as being integrated into the chopping board. The bin is not described as being mounted above the cooker. The cooking stick is not mentioned in any of the visual observations. Therefore, the correct statement is that there was no bin.
